tools.name: webinars_webinar
tools.description: Retrieve a webinar. Required: webinarId. Returns the WebinarsWebinarResponse.

tools.name: webinars_panelists_webinar
tools.description: List panelists for a webinar. Required: webinarId. Returns the WebinarPanelistList.

tools.name: webinars_panelists_webinar-create
tools.description: Add panelist to webinar. Required: webinarId. Optional: panelists. Returns the new PanelistsWebinarCreateResponse.

tools.name: webinars_panelists_webinar-delete
tools.description: Remove all panelists from a webinar. Required: webinarId. Destructive.

tools.name: webinars_panelists_webinar-delete-webinars
tools.description: Remove a panelist from a webinar. Required: webinarId, panelistId. Destructive.

tools.name: webinars_polls_webinar
tools.description: List polls of a webinar. Required: webinarId. Returns the PollList.

tools.name: webinars_polls_webinar-create
tools.description: Create a poll for a webinar. Required: webinarId. Optional: questions, title. Returns the new PollsWebinarCreateResponse.

tools.name: webinars_polls_webinar-delete
tools.description: Delete a webinar's Poll. Required: webinarId, pollId. Destructive.

tools.name: webinars_polls_webinar-get
tools.description: Retrieve a webinar's poll. Required: webinarId, pollId. Returns the PollsWebinarGetResponse.

tools.name: webinars_polls_webinar-update
tools.description: Update a webinar's poll. Required: webinarId, pollId. Optional: questions, title.

tools.name: webinars_registrants_webinar

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned within a single API call

params.name: page_number
params.description: Current page number of returned records

tools.description: Add a registrant for a webinar. Required: webinarId, email, first_name, last_name. Optional: occurrence_ids, address, city (plus 12 more). Returns the new RegistrantsWebinarCreateResponse.
